frame: Exact interaction picture of the local electronic Hamiltonian.
limits: Bare logical subspace must be invariant under local evolution.
Population diagnostics do not quantify all phase or gate errors.

provenance.geometry_and_field: Prescribed theoretical baseline; lab z is the common NV axis.
provenance.gamma_e: Positive coefficient g_e=-gamma_e_phys in H_Z=g_e B.S; magnitude g_e/(2*pi) approximately 28024.95 MHz/T. The physical electron gyromagnetic ratio is negative.
provenance.bare_detuning: Chosen zero reference-minus-transition detuning before dipolar projection shifts.
provenance.units: Positions: m; fields: T; gradients: T/m; D, E and detuning: rad/us; gamma_e: rad/us/T.
provenance.constraints: Chosen trial bounds: minimum separation 5 nm and maximum field magnitude 20 mT at NV sites; not validated fabrication or hardware limits.
provenance.numerics: Chosen baseline: static interval exponentials and comparison tolerances of 1e-10; numerical accuracy must be checked during propagation.
